title: Build fails at 100% with deprecated=no and production=yes
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in v4.6.dev.custom_build [019889d1d]

### System information

Linux Mint 22.2. HP laptop with Ryzen 5 5625U and integrated graphics.

### Issue description

Editor build fails at 100% with this error:
```
[100%] Compiling platform/web/export/export_plugin.cpp ...
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp: In static member function 'static String EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_get_keystore_path(const Ref<EditorExportPreset>&, bool)':
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:1708:16: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 1708 |         return ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(keystore_path).simplify_path();
      |                ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp: In member function 'virtual String EditorExportPlatformAndroid::get_export_option_warning(const EditorExportPreset*, const StringName&) const':
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:2082:50: error: 'GLOBAL_GET' was not declared in this scope
 2082 |                         String export_renderer = GLOBAL_GET("rendering/renderer/rendering_method.mobile");
      |                                                  ^~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp: In member function 'Error EditorExportPlatformAndroid::sign_apk(const Ref<EditorExportPreset>&, bool, const String&, EditorProgress&)':
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3257:20: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3257 |         apk_path = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(apk_path).simplify_path();
      |                    ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp: In member function 'String EditorExportPlatformAndroid::_resolve_export_plugin_android_library_path(const String&) const':
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3468:41: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3468 |                         absolute_path = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(p_android_library_path);
      |                                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3471:41: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3471 |                         absolute_path = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(export_plugin_absolute_path);
      |                                         ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp: In member function 'Error EditorExportPlatformAndroid::export_project_helper(const Ref<EditorExportPreset>&, bool, const String&, int, bool, BitField<EditorExportPlatform::DebugFlags>)':
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3751:37: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3751 |                 String build_path = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(gradle_build_directory);
      |                                     ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3827:43: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3827 |                 String addons_directory = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path("res://addons");
      |                                           ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
platform/android/export/export_plugin.cpp:3920:31: error: 'ProjectSettings' has not been declared
 3920 |                 export_path = ProjectSettings::get_singleton()->globalize_path(export_path).simplify_path();
      |                               ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
[100%] Compiling platform/windows/export/export.cpp ...
scons: *** [bin/obj/platform/android/export/export_plugin.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.o] Error 1
```

### Steps to reproduce

Build godot editor from the latest main with deprecated=no and production=yes

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

There's no project since is an error generated building the engine.
